column7: THREATMODEL-VERIFY-1, #2795 read side: every role reader tested a scoped grant's project/environment with deleted_at IS NULL on a LEFT JOIN, which is also true when the row is missing, so a purged project's (or environment's) leftover grants kept authorizing at that id. A scoped grant now needs its row to exist and be live, in all six readers: GetUserRoleIDsAt, GetUserGroupRoleIDsAt, GetMachineRoleIDsAt, ResolveUserPermissionAt, ResolveMachinePermissionAt (the live auth path) and ListUserRoleGrants, plus the machine value-read prefetch (TestReadPathPrefetch_MissingEnvironmentRowAuthorizesNothing). Red on main for every reader and both rows; the test also runs a Postgres leg when KEYORIX_TEST_PG_DSN is set (INV-STORE-scoped-grant-needs-live-scope-row).
